Alex Morgan: Hey team — hitting a production issue where embeddings for a small fraction of requests look corrupted (extra tokens + profile PII). Need to debug with raw request/response bodies for ~50 example traces. Can I get temporary access or a one-off dump? Linking support ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-6791

Maria Chen: @Alex what's the minimal set you need? do you need full auth headers? session cookies?

Alex Morgan: Only the request/response body + LLM prompt/resp. Will strip Authorization header on our side if you prefer. Need the originals to reproduce tokenization/escape issues.

Chris Patel: We should avoid sending auth tokens. Ops prefers provisioning an ephemeral s3 URL that expires. If security ok with scope, infra can stage objects with 24h TTL.

Nina Gomez: Is there an option to pseudonymize PII (hash user id, mask emails) instead of raw? Might be enough for the pattern I need to reproduce.

Maria Chen: Policy TL;DR: raw bodies containing PII require explicit approval. We can grant temporary access if: 1) ticket with justification + list of ppl, 2) expiration <= 24h (prefer 12h), 3) tokens/auth stripped or replaced with HMAC, 4) audit log entry + owner (requester), 5) minimal sample set.

security-bot: Policy snapshot: /policies/logging-redaction.md (v2.1) — requests with PII must follow manual-approval workflow.

Alex Morgan: I'll create a ticket and list myself + Nina. I can HMAC user_id/email and redact OAuth tokens. Quick Q: acceptable HMAC approach?

Maria Chen: HMAC with a per-environment key (rotate yearly) is fine. Include salt/algorithm in ticket. Example we accept: 
```
import hmac, hashlib
key = b"ENV_DEBUG_KEY"
def hmac_hex(s):
    return hmac.new(key, s.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
```
Send only the hex, not the raw identifiers.

Chris Patel: Infra will host the files under rw-prod-debug/<ticket>/ and set ACL to internal-only. We'll attach CloudTrail-style access logs. I can do 12h expiry if Maria signs off.

Maria Chen: OK. Conditional approval: once ticket is created with justification and list (Alex, Nina), and you upload HMAC'd samples (no auth headers, no full cookies), Security approves a 12-hour ephemeral S3 dump. Please ensure you provide exact subset (50 traces max) and a short replication plan.

Alex Morgan: Got it. I'll file RW-6792 now, include HMAC samples, and request 12h window. Will also paste the reproduction steps.

Nina Gomez: Thanks — I'll be on standby to validate once the link is up.

infra: Noted — @Chris will provision after ticket creation, will ping when available.

Maria Chen: One more thing: please do not include any user-uploaded files or attachments in the dump. If you think you need those, escalate separately.

Alex Morgan: Understood. Filing RW-6792 and will tag you both. Thanks! :thumbsup: 

Maria Chen: Approved conditionally; waiting on ticket and uploaded HMAC'd samples. Once done, infra, please create the S3 URL and post here.
